scope: Local read-only source audit and binary64 arithmetic illustrations. No author trainer, new model/gradient run, altered production estimator, normalization, clipping, scale, tolerance or acceptance gate.

author_official_GRPO_behavior.entry: Trainer GRPO branch uses native token_level_rewards, response_mask and uid, calls original author core. Native training recipe32 initial prompt groups,8 responses each, original terminal TextCraft score0/1.
author_official_GRPO_behavior.score_reduction: Each complete trajectory score is token_level_rewards.sum(-1). UID groups share the original prompt; group id does not depend on DT request order.
author_official_GRPO_behavior.baseline: For group size>1, original torch.mean of scores and original torch.std of those scores; epsilon1e-6. The std call has default sample correction1, using n-1 denominator. For n8 no singleton fallback is active.
author_official_GRPO_behavior.advantage: (G - group_mean)/(group_std + 1e-6); one scalar per trajectory tiled across original response_mask active action tokens.
author_official_GRPO_behavior.G0_in_mixed_group: Negative original GRPO advantage, not zero.
author_official_GRPO_behavior.G1_in_mixed_group: Positive original GRPO advantage, with size depending on the success count.
author_official_GRPO_behavior.all0_or_all1_group: Mean equals each score; advantages zero for all action tokens. Original entropy/KL loss can still operate.
author_official_GRPO_behavior.aggregation: No author function named agg_loss is called here. Actual author PG uses masked_mean, and actor entropy/KL also use masked_mean over original response_mask. Author masked_mean is sum(loss*mask)/sum(mask). No second advantage whitening in its GRPO entry.
author_official_GRPO_behavior.evidence_limit: This is pinned author source/config behavior, not a new execution of the author trainer or claims of unchanged training performance.

fixed_VERL_official_GRPO_behavior.mean_std: Same outcome-score group mean and sample std formula; norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo defaultsTrue.
fixed_VERL_official_GRPO_behavior.multi_turn_mask: Original entry selects native loss_mask response tail in multi_turn mode, then passes uid and traj_uid to original core.
fixed_VERL_official_GRPO_behavior.traj_and_step_option: Core supports compute_mean_std_cross_steps defaultTrue. False deduplicates(uid,traj_uid) before statistics. In a TextCraft full-trajectory batch with exactly one original row per distinct trajectory, both choices use the same8 scores. No response-history multiplicity is assumed for the numeric table.
fixed_VERL_official_GRPO_behavior.broadcast: Normalized scalar is expanded over original response_mask; returns equals advantages for this original GRPO branch.
fixed_VERL_official_GRPO_behavior.aggregation: Actual current token-mean path calls original agg_loss -> masked_mean, dividing each microbatch masked loss sum by native action mask sum+1e-8. This is the existing loss owner used after either GRPO or DT advantages.
fixed_VERL_official_GRPO_behavior.non_active_path: Actual stopped TextCraft job selects DELTATRACE, not GRPO. Reading original GRPO source does not mean it was active in that job.

exact_DT_replacement_difference.unchanged_owner: Original VERL actor loss, ratio, dual clip, entropy/KL, loss_mask, update loop and optimizer remain owners, as bounded prior audit proves for actor update AST/core SHA. No GRPO group normalization is applied after DT Q/V/A.
exact_DT_replacement_difference.return: Native complete future returnG is built before DP splitting. For binary terminal TextCraft scores, sampled G is0 or1 including official stopping.
exact_DT_replacement_difference.token_advantage: Q_i=G; V_i=G*exp(-d_i); A_i=G*(-expm1(-d_i)). Each token retains its own signed counterfactual entry.
exact_DT_replacement_difference.G0: Q=V=A=0 for active actions; readout RPC skipped only. Those actions stay in original actor mask/denominator and original entropy/KL.
exact_DT_replacement_difference.G1: A_i=1-exp(-d_i), potentially positive, zero or negative; it is not determined by group success count or broadcast as a group scalar.
exact_DT_replacement_difference.all0_group: DT task PG zero, as for GRPO all0, while original regularizers remain.
exact_DT_replacement_difference.all1_group: GRPO task advantages zero after group centering. DT token advantages need not be zero; whether they vanish depends on each deletion effect, not equal sampled rewards among eight trajectories.
exact_DT_replacement_difference.mixed_n8_group: GRPO assigns positive successful trajectory and negative failed trajectory coefficients after centering/std; DT G0 samples have zero task coefficient and successful samples contain tokenwise positive/negative coefficients. This differs in centering, resolution and stochastic variance/scale; it is not only a constant rescale.
exact_DT_replacement_difference.inference_scope: These different learning signals are the specified estimator replacement. They are not, by themselves, evidence of interface error, invalid counterfactual values, excessive regularization, or the cause of smooth historical degradation.

n8_numeric_formula_account.arithmetic: Offline Python binary64 illustration of original formula with n8, distinct trajectories, binary0/1 scores, correction1 and epsilon1e-6. No Torch owner test was executed; values are not asserted bitwise FP32 outputs.

n8_numeric_formula_account.token_weighting_limit: Group mean/std are across trajectory scores. Subsequent native actor token-mean weights trajectory contributions by its active token count inside each microbatch. A zero group average of coefficients is not a zero model gradient; token log-probability Jacobians differ.
n8_numeric_formula_account.example_scope: The DT d examples are illustrative mathematical cases only, not observed or typical token values, thresholds, calibration or changed parameters.

gradient_coefficient_correspondence.scope: Original token PPO PG objective at ratio1 with finite forwards, away from clipping changes. Local derivative coefficient with respect to token log_prob is -A_i/native action-token denominator, then the same original accumulation scale. This is not a measured full model gradient.
gradient_coefficient_correspondence.mixed_group_failed_tokens: GRPO supplies nonzero negative A in mixed groups; DT G0 supplies zero task PG coefficient. Entropy/KL remain unchanged in either path.
gradient_coefficient_correspondence.successful_tokens: GRPO supplies normalized positive scalar; DT supplies tokenwise signed coefficients. Source differences alone do not quantify cosine, cancellation, full-batch component norms or update direction.
gradient_coefficient_correspondence.historical_limit: No complete historical35-40 minibatch token arrays/component gradients retained. Earlier v1 real success-only B4 component norms cannot establish regularizer dominance over full training or failure rows.

conclusion: Official TextCraft GRPO standardizes scalar outcome scores within original eight-trajectory prompt groups and broadcasts them over action masks. The fixed VERL GRPO is equivalent on one-row-per-trajectory n8 groups with normalization enabled.

DT intentionally replaces this with unnormalized tokenwise counterfactual Q/V/A; G0 task PG vanishes while mixed GRPO failure PG does not, and all-success GRPO vanishes while DT may not. This is an explicit method signal/scale/variance difference, not an extra shadow behavior found by this audit.

The difference is relevant to investigating gradual quality change, but no runtime comparison, historical full-batch gradient impact, primary-cause claim, loss rescale or regularizer change follows from these source/numeric illustrations.

same_full_batch_GRPO_diagnostic_metadata.original_full_PPO_batch: uid contains32 original prompt-group UUIDs each repeated8 times; traj_uid contains256 original trajectory UUIDs. Native DataProto reorder moves both metadata arrays with original tensors. Current UID and traj_uid are distinct and must both be used by the fixed VERL GRPO core.
same_full_batch_GRPO_diagnostic_metadata.group_uid_argument: Original author uses index=data.non_tensor_batch[uid]. Fixed VERL additionally takes traj_index=data.non_tensor_batch[traj_uid]. Never substitute traj_uid for group uid.
same_full_batch_GRPO_diagnostic_metadata.DT_response_table: Credit response metadata and prepare_training_credit intentionally retain traj_uid/env_step only; they are not a source of original32-group uid. A sorted DT response subset does not contain the complete native GRPO comparison batch.

matched_record_subset.scope: Only recorded minimum DT response samples, not the full original PPO batch.

same_full_batch_GRPO_diagnostic_metadata.missing_evidence: No locally retained exact historical full-trajectory actor DataProto for35-40 with original uid/traj_uid, input_ids/responses/attention_mask/loss_mask/position_ids/token_level_rewards/DT advantages/old/ref logp and native minibatch order. Rollout dumps cannot supply group UUID or exact training masks/IDs.
same_full_batch_GRPO_diagnostic_metadata.owner_reuse_if_actual_batch_available: At the original update boundary, the same original full DataProto supplies native uid/traj_uid, original final rewards and action masks. Official compute_grpo_outcome_advantage can then produce a diagnostic-only alternate advantage tensor while original actor/loss compute both component gradients at the same policy and native minibatch. No data reconstruction, second rollout or replacement training is warranted.
same_full_batch_GRPO_diagnostic_metadata.prohibited_inference: Do not recover group identities from equal prompt strings, infer uid by row position after balancing, decode/re-encode native trajectories, or treat selected successful B4 as original8-response groups.
same_full_batch_GRPO_diagnostic_metadata.current_status: Source interface identified, exact historical full-batch gradient comparison not performed. This audit starts no rollout or model run.
